_notes.rootDirectory: Set the service Root Directory to 'backend' in the Railway dashboard so the build context (and .dockerignore) is backend/. Then dockerfilePath 'Dockerfile' resolves to backend/Dockerfile.
_notes.volume: Attach a Railway volume mounted at /data (INFINITUM_DATA) so the SQLite DB survives redeploys.
_notes.env: Set in the dashboard / `railway variables`: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, INFINITUM_ADMIN_TOKEN, INFINITUM_ENABLE_SCHEDULER=true, INFINITUM_WAKE_HOUR=9, INFINITUM_TZ=UTC, INFINITUM_DATA=/data, INFINITUM_DB=/data/infinitum.db. Never commit secrets.
